title: PriVA run parameters
description: Documentation schema; required parameters and scientific input contracts are actively validated by main.nf and priva task.

input.description: Whole original cohort VCF; annotation keeps its complete sample context

vcf_index.description: Matching tabix index, defaults to input plus .tbi

ped.description: Original full cohort PED; preserve each family's proband-first row order. Without it, one run covers all samples without family filtering

family.description: Run only this PED family; by default every PED family runs

annotation_hub.description: Annotation hub folder: stored step results reused across runs (also --action hub_refresh)

resources_lock.description: resources.lock.json from --action install; annotation hub folders are then named from install-step lineages

legacy_config.description: Explicit prepared legacy configuration; caches are not installed or remapped

resource_manifest.description: Frozen inventory generated by priva task manifest

priva_binary.description: The PriVA program that runs the task contract (priva task) and the read-only task boundary

software_id.description: Pinned image digest or explicitly exported environment lock identity

slurm_cluster_options.description: Extra sbatch options for every task, such as --constraint=NAME

local_cpus.description: CPUs the local executor may give to tasks; the installed driver itself sees 2

container_run_options.description: Extra apptainer run options, such as -B binds for the cache and data folders
